ndangira.description:
EXTERNAL ADVERTISEMENT OF VACANT POSTS TO THE POSITION OF RELATIONSHIP OFFICERS
UMUTANGUHA Finance Company (UFC) Plc, a company duly registered in the office of the Registrar General under company code number 101310843, licensed by National Bank of Rwanda to operate as Micro Finance Institution in Rwanda headquartered in Kigali, Opposite Nyamirambo Pele Stadium, House # 177, KN2 Avenue, P.O Box 2998 Kigali, Tel 0788387730, email: info@ufinance.co.rw is recruiting self-motivated, creative, persuasive individuals with excellent communication and sales skills to fill the positions of Relationship Officers with the following duties and responsibilities:
A. Responsibilities with regard to saving mobilization
The Relationship Officer “RO” is responsible for the growth of deposit volume at branch level by mobilizing accounts and savings from field (from current and potential clients). The RO will be responsible for the development of the relationship between clients and UFC. His/her specific tasks are to: 

Generate & develop deposits and new deposit pipeline by providing product knowledge, customer services and managing customer relationships
Sell the Deposits products to the existing and potential clients
Enhance and establish relationship with existing & perspective customers in the segment by visiting/talking to clients on a daily basis
Solicit new business from present and prospective customers; maintains ongoing business relationships with present customers in order to take advantage of additional cross-selling opportunities.
Involve in savings promotion activities according to specificities of areas.
Follow up and make sure that the accounts activated by his/her promotion are actively used by the customers.
Manage the High Network Individuals customer portfolio for the branch.
Ensure establishment and maintenance of the strong rapport with the clients
Achieve all business targets within allocated time

B. Responsibilities with regard to credit 
The RO is responsible of the quality loan portfolio and its growth at the assigned branch with the following duties:

Mobilize clients for the purpose of lending to them.
Train individual clients and group members in the UFC lending methodology
Supervise financial education trainings conducted by clients’ trainer
Guide, monitor, and supervise clients as well as groups activities
Evaluate and assess the credit risk of individual clients and groups by inspecting business and household of potential clients, appraise client’s business and repayment capability before disbursing loans.
Generate and submit on time accurate documentation to enable loans to be disbursed.
Maintain complete and accurate loan documentation in the office and supervise the maintenance of group record keeping process.
Follow up with clients to recover loans. 
Participate and/or hold cluster meetings. 
Take individual action as per policy to recover delinquent loans
Prepare and submit reports on the number of clients, repayments, portfolio quality, loan recoveries and follow-up action on delinquent loans.
Prepare and submit reports on the number of clients, repayments, portfolio quality, loan recoveries and follow-up action on delinquent loans. 

C. Sell of all financial products, services and delivery channels

Develop marketing and work plan for the establishment of solid clientele base. 
Identify and sensitize the potential clients in the respective area of operation. 
Advise clients on the use of UFC PLC Alternative delivery channels
Refer clients that are illegible for other UFC PLC products to the respective departments 

Main Performance Measures

Portfolio at risk (PAR)
Value of outstanding portfolio (Average portfolio)
Number of loan clients
Growth in the number of loan clients
Growth in the value of outstanding portfolio
Growth of the saving portfolio 
Number of saving clients

Client relationship

Ensure a perfect, good and quality customer service 
Compliance with Client Protection Principles
Safeguard the good reputation of UMUTANGUHA FINANCE COMPANY PLC
Any other task assigned by the line supervisor.

Requirements: 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Management, Finance and Banking and related fields 
At least 3 years’ experience in banking or micro finance sector preferably in Business or Credit sections;
Excellent understanding of the bank operations and credit functionalities
Negotiation and strong analytical skills
Excellent sales skills and strong credit analysis and loan portfolio management;
Excellent and effective communication skills, both orally and in writing 
Able to work in any UFC Plc Branches located in all provinces in Rwanda
Having a driving license Category A will be an added value;
Maximum age 38 years’ old

Application documents: 

Application letter
Curriculum vitae
Copy of ID card
Studies documents (copies of Certificates, academic transcripts, degree, etc)
Training and experience documents
A list of three references and their contacts

Note: All documents should be scanned in one document and be electronically submitted to: ufc.recruitment@ufinance.co.rw (Please mention the position you are applying for in the email subject).
The deadline for receiving applications is 28th September 2026 at 5:00 PM
NB: 

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Done at Kigali, 17th September 2026. 
 Mrs. Josephine MUKUNDIYIMANA Mr. Noel MUHAWENIMANA
 HR& Admin Manager Chief Executive Officer

ndangira.title_raw: Head of Programs at Plan International Rwanda: (Deadline 30-09-2026)
ndangira.description:
Career Opportunities: Head of Programmes (54963)
The Organisation
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.
Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.
For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.
We won’t stop until we are all equal.
ROLE PURPOSE
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.
Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge. We won’t stop until we are all equal.
The Head of Programmes is responsible for leading and providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for designing, implementing and evaluating quality gender transformative programmes and influencing that are consistent with the Country Strategy of Plan International Rwanda and Plan International standards, priorities and principles for advancing children and youth’s rights and equality for girls.
As a staff member of a child-centred international development and humanitarian organisation, the Head of Programmes will commit to complying with Plan International’s standards and policies related to Safeguarding and PSHEA (Preventing Sexual Harassment, Exploitation and Abuse), gender equality, inclusion and diversity. All Plan staff are expected to uphold the organisation's values and behaviours in every aspect of their work.
The Head of Programmes provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all programmatic aspects of the country office. S/He is responsible for developing and executing programmes aligned with the country office strategy, ensuring high-quality, gender-transformative projects that advance children and youth’s rights, with a focus on girls' equality. S/He works closely with Programme Managers, Project Managers, and Programme Unit Managers to oversee project design, planning, implementation, monitoring, risk and budget management, and project closure, all within the framework of the Country Strategy and Plan International standards of project management and of management standards.
As a strategic member of the Country Management Team, the Head of Programme provides strategic vision on the implementation of the Country strategy but also supports the Country Office through its technical advisers in fundraising, through positioning and supporting the development of strong quality proposals.
S/He also plays a crucial role in integrating safeguarding policies into programmatic work, ensuring that all activities are carried out with the highest standards of safety and protection for children and youth.
By fostering collaboration, driving continuous learning, and influencing positive change, the Head of Programmes plays a pivotal role in shaping impactful, sustainable programmes that transform the lives of children, girls and young people across the country.
To view the Job description click here: Head of Programmes_JD.pdf
Location: Country Office-Kigali
Type of Role: Head of Programmes (For Rwandan National Only) 
Reports to: Country Director
Grade: Level 18
Closing Date: 30/09/2026
Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.
We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.
Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.
We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.
Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.
A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.
Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates. 
CLICK HERE TO READ MORE AND APPLY

We won’t stop until we are all equal.
ROLE PURPOSE
Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.
Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge. We won’t stop until we are all equal.
The Head of Programmes is responsible for leading and providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for designing, implementing and evaluating quality gender transformative programmes and influencing that are consistent with the Country Strategy of Plan International Rwanda and Plan International standards, priorities and principles for advancing children and youth’s rights and equality for girls.
As a staff member of a child-centred international development and humanitarian organisation, the Head of Programmes will commit to complying with Plan International’s standards and policies related to Safeguarding and PSHEA (Preventing Sexual Harassment, Exploitation and Abuse), gender equality, inclusion and diversity. All Plan staff are expected to uphold the organisation's values and behaviours in every aspect of their work.
The Head of Programmes provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all programmatic aspects of the country office. S/He is responsible for developing and executing programmes aligned with the country office strategy, ensuring high-quality, gender-transformative projects that advance children and youth’s rights, with a focus on girls' equality. S/He works closely with Programme Managers, Project Managers, and Programme Unit Managers to oversee project design, planning, implementation, monitoring, risk and budget management, and project closure, all within the framework of the Country Strategy and Plan International standards of project management and of management standards.
As a strategic member of the Country Management Team, the Head of Programme provides strategic vision on the implementation of the Country strategy but also supports the Country Office through its technical advisers in fundraising, through positioning and supporting the development of strong quality proposals.
S/He also plays a crucial role in integrating safeguarding policies into programmatic work, ensuring that all activities are carried out with the highest standards of safety and protection for children and youth.
By fostering collaboration, driving continuous learning, and influencing positive change, the Head of Programmes plays a pivotal role in shaping impactful, sustainable programmes that transform the lives of children, girls and young people across the country.
To view the Job description click here: Head of Programmes_JD.pdf
Location: Country Office-Kigali
Type of Role: Head of Programmes (For Rwandan National Only) 
Reports to: Country Director
Grade: Level 18
Closing Date: 30/09/2026
Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.
We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.
Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.
We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.
Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.
A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.
Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates.

4 Job Positions at Wicloud: (Deadline 16-10-2026)
IT LEAD JD
COMPANY INTRODUCTION
Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.
Download Travel Guides

Location: Kigali, RwandaEmployment Type: Full-timeWorking Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced IT Lead to oversee IT operations, infrastructure, security, compliance, team development, and technology innovation for Wicloudrwd's Kigali operations.
The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership, establish effective IT processes and controls, and ensure that IT services meet business and client requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. IT Operations & Governance

Oversee end-to-end IT operations in Kigali.
Establish clear IT governance, roles, responsibilities, and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure timely incident reporting, coordination, and resolution for major IT issues.
Provide regular IT status, risk, and improvement reports to management.

2. Infrastructure & Service Management

Manage corporate networks (LAN/WAN/VPN), servers, cloud resources, endpoints, and collaboration tools.
Ensure office and production environments meet business SLA requirements.
Own the IT asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement.
Manage external vendors and service providers.

3. Information Security & Compliance

Implement and maintain IT security and compliance controls required for business lines.
Support internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance assessments.
Define and enforce IT security policies, incident response plans, and awareness programs.
Ensure appropriate access control, identity management, and data protection.

4. AI Enablement & Innovation

Identify and implement AI solutions to enhance IT operations and productivity.
Drive adoption of AI tools to optimize internal workflows and service delivery.
Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate AI into support and business processes.

5. Team Leadership & Development

Lead and manage IT teams across multiple offices.
Set clear performance objectives and accountability mechanisms.
Improve execution, professionalism, and internal service credibility of the IT function.
Build standardized processes to reduce dependency on individuals.

6. Cross-functional & International Communication

Work closely with business, compliance, security, operations, and other functional teams.
Communicate effectively in English with overseas leadership teams.
Translate technical issues into structured, business-oriented updates for non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Requirements
Required

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
6+ years of IT experience, including 2–3 years in an IT Lead or equivalent role.
Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with solid knowledge of ITSM and security compliance.
Practical experience applying AI in operations and/or productivity.

Technical & Professional Skills

Proven experience managing IT for multi-site or mid-to-large organizations is a plus.
Solid foundation in networking, systems, and enterprise IT environments.
Familiarity with ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
Hands-on experience with information security and compliance in international service environments.
Cloud platform experience, such as Microsoft Azure, is a strong advantage.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

Strong ownership mindset and risk awareness.
Proactive, structured, and execution-driven.
Able to lead teams with authority and credibility.
Comfortable working under high standards and client scrutiny.

AI-related Experience
Experience with one or more of the following is expected:

Generative AI and LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini.
Prompt engineering.
AI automation for operations.
AI chatbot implementation.
AI knowledge base development.
AI-enabled process automation.
AI for ticket triage in support environments.
AI workflow optimization.
AI-driven reporting.

Language Requirements

Local Language: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.
English: Strong professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Application Process
Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

Rwanda development board

Review and respond to user questions in the Windows Community Forum.
Monitor assigned community threads and ensure questions receive appropriate attention.

Strong written communication skills with a professional, respectful, and empathetic tone.

Technical knowledge of Windows and Microsoft products is preferred.
Experience in online support, customer service, community moderation, or technical troubleshooting is an advantage.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Ability to research technical issues and communicate solutions clearly.
Commitment to confidentiality and solution-oriented customer support.

Community guidelines and etiquette training.
Access to knowledge base documents, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.
Hands-on practice with the IXPT Tool for thread management.
Simulated practice threads before handling live cases.

Benefits

Flexible, remote work opportunities.
Access to Microsoft Learn resources and training.
Opportunity to grow technical expertise and reputation in the community.
Monthly income is based on contributions.

Application Process
Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

Deliver technical support services to Microsoft global customers while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Document technical work, findings, and research to support colleagues and improve the product and customer support experience.
Collaborate with relevant teams when additional technical expertise is required.

Maintain a proactive approach to customer satisfaction.
Identify customer satisfaction concerns and manage customer expectations appropriately.
Communicate technical information clearly and professionally.

Participate in planned team-wide shift rotations to support business needs.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

Position: OFFICE MANAGER
Terms of Reference: Rwanda Institute of Mediation Office Manager:
Location:KigaliPosition Type:Full-TimeReports to:The Board of Rwanda Institute of Mediation (RIM)
Travel Guides & Travelogues

1. Position Summary 
The Office Manager is the backbone of RIM’s daily operations, ensuring a well-organized and managed RIM secretariat.
This role requires managing administrative complexities while serving members and stakeholders with an open-minded attitude to address all issues that will foster strengthening institutional development and advancing members welfare.
2. Key Terms of Reference and Responsibilities:

Assisting in Development and implementing the RIM strategic plan and initiatives, including activities and action plans to position RIM at high standard of profession.
Office management, manage institutional property, and ensure operational efficiency
Organizing RIM members and public complaints handled by the RIM c organs; 
Assisting in Handling members’ and clients’ correspondences to ensure that their concerns and inquiries are adequately addressed;
Periodically evaluate RIM membership needs and inform strategies for the RIM Board to adopt in order to ensure continued satisfaction and appreciation by its members;
Developing and maintaining database of reliable and authentic information on the members of RIM;
Assisting in the designing and implementation of members’ welfare programs and activities; 
Assisting in identification of emerging issues and areas of training for members;
Assisting in formulation and implementation of a Continuous Professional Development (CPD) program;
Maintaining an efficient CPD database at the Secretariat;
Promoting RIM partnership with other training institutions at national regional and international level; 
Coordinating, implementing & Evaluating the RIM Pro bono services & initiatives;
Assisting in the development of the RIM program related projects;
Initiating and generating strategies to promote Professional Development within RIM membership;
Preparing and submitting monthly, quarterly and annual activity work plans and progressive reports to his/her superior
Any other lawful duties as may be assigned by the superior organ or individuals. 

3. Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in either Business Administration, Management, Law, Public Administration, Project management or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in office management, executive administration, or project coordination (experience in NGO environment is preferred).
Fluency in Kinyarwanda and either or both of the two other official languages (English or French) (written and spoken) is required. Working knowledge of the other is a strong asset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and cloud-based collaboration tools (Google Workspace).

4. Core Competencies

Strict commitment to confidentiality and data privacy.
Strong organizational habits with the ability to multitask under tight deadlines.
Basic understanding of Rwanda's legal framework and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) landscape.
A commitment to integrating well-disciplined values—such as integrity, compassion, and diligence—into daily work.

5. Application Process
Travel Guides & Travelogues
Interested candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter in one PDF format, explaining how their professional skills align with the position to proffesionalmediators@gmail.com by 25th September 2026.

FINANCE LEAD JD
COMPANY INTRODUCTION
Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.
Location: Kigali, RwandaEmployment Type: Full-timeWorking Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
About the Role
We are seeking a hands-on Finance Lead to independently manage the Company's routine accounting, tax compliance, payroll, project costing, and local finance administration.
The Finance Lead will work closely with the Kigali team and HQ Finance & Operations functions to ensure accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, and compliance with applicable Rwanda requirements.
The successful candidate must be able to independently perform core finance activities and possess a sound academic and professional understanding of more complex financial and tax concepts.
Key Responsibilities
1. Accounting & Financial Reporting

Independently manage full-cycle accounting, including:

Journal entries.
Accounts payable and receivable.
Accruals and bank reconciliations.
Fixed asset records and depreciation.

Manage month-end closing and preparation of monthly financial reports.
Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.
Prepare schedules and information for management, audit, and statutory purposes.

2. Tax, Invoice & Payroll Compliance

Independently manage routine Rwanda finance and compliance matters, including:

VAT, PAYE, withholding tax, and other applicable statutory obligations.
Invoice and supporting document compliance.
Payroll records, statutory deductions, and employer contributions.
Tax filing deadlines, supporting documentation, and statutory records.

Coordinate with the Rwanda Revenue Authority, auditors, and external tax advisors.
Review the accounting and basic tax treatment of revenue and expense transactions and identify potential tax benefits or exposures.

3. Project Costing & Financial Control

Maintain project and cost center records.
Track and allocate direct and indirect costs.
Prepare project costing, profitability analysis, and budget-versus-actual reporting.
Support cash-flow forecasting and management reporting.
Identify financial control or compliance issues and report them to management or relevant HQ functions.

4. Financial Administration & External Coordination

Prepare payment documentation and maintain finance records in accordance with company policies.
Support the implementation of finance SOPs and internal controls.
Act as the primary local finance contact for banks, auditors, accounting firms, and tax advisors.
Coordinate with external advisors on tax, accounting, and regulatory matters and follow up on agreed actions.
Prepare information and supporting documents requested by HQ or external advisors.

5. Finance & Tax Knowledge
The candidate should have a sound understanding of finance and tax principles and be able to recognize relevant issues, understand their potential implications, and escalate matters where necessary.
Knowledge should include:

Cross-border transactions and foreign exchange.
Profit repatriation and related financial considerations.
Transfer pricing and related-party transactions.
Intercompany arrangements and cost allocation.
Relevant tax, foreign exchange, and documentation requirements.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting or finance experience.
Demonstrated experience in full-cycle accounting, month-end closing, and financial reporting.
Practical experience with Rwanda tax compliance, payroll, and statutory reporting.
Experience in project costing, cost allocation, or profitability analysis.
Proficiency in accounting software or ERP systems and Microsoft 365, particularly Excel.
Strong written and spoken English.
Ability to work independently and manage routine finance operations in a start-up environment.
Partial completion of ACCA, CPA, or another recognized professional accounting qualification is an advantage.
Experience in IT, technology, outsourcing, or professional services is an advantage

Local Language: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.
English: Strong professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Application Process
Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

ndangira.description:
IT LEAD JD
COMPANY INTRODUCTION
Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.
Location: Kigali, RwandaEmployment Type: Full-timeWorking Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced IT Lead to oversee IT operations, infrastructure, security, compliance, team development, and technology innovation for Wicloudrwd's Kigali operations.
The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership, establish effective IT processes and controls, and ensure that IT services meet business and client requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. IT Operations & Governance

Oversee end-to-end IT operations in Kigali.
Establish clear IT governance, roles, responsibilities, and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure timely incident reporting, coordination, and resolution for major IT issues.
Provide regular IT status, risk, and improvement reports to management.

2. Infrastructure & Service Management

Manage corporate networks (LAN/WAN/VPN), servers, cloud resources, endpoints, and collaboration tools.
Ensure office and production environments meet business SLA requirements.
Own the IT asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement.
Manage external vendors and service providers.

3. Information Security & Compliance

Implement and maintain IT security and compliance controls required for business lines.
Support internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance assessments.
Define and enforce IT security policies, incident response plans, and awareness programs.
Ensure appropriate access control, identity management, and data protection.

4. AI Enablement & Innovation

Identify and implement AI solutions to enhance IT operations and productivity.
Drive adoption of AI tools to optimize internal workflows and service delivery.
Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate AI into support and business processes.

5. Team Leadership & Development

Lead and manage IT teams across multiple offices.
Set clear performance objectives and accountability mechanisms.
Improve execution, professionalism, and internal service credibility of the IT function.
Build standardized processes to reduce dependency on individuals.

6. Cross-functional & International Communication

Work closely with business, compliance, security, operations, and other functional teams.
Communicate effectively in English with overseas leadership teams.
Translate technical issues into structured, business-oriented updates for non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Requirements
Required

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
6+ years of IT experience, including 2–3 years in an IT Lead or equivalent role.
Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with solid knowledge of ITSM and security compliance.
Practical experience applying AI in operations and/or productivity.

Technical & Professional Skills

Proven experience managing IT for multi-site or mid-to-large organizations is a plus.
Solid foundation in networking, systems, and enterprise IT environments.
Familiarity with ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
Hands-on experience with information security and compliance in international service environments.
Cloud platform experience, such as Microsoft Azure, is a strong advantage.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

Strong ownership mindset and risk awareness.
Proactive, structured, and execution-driven.
Able to lead teams with authority and credibility.
Comfortable working under high standards and client scrutiny.

AI-related Experience
Experience with one or more of the following is expected:

Generative AI and LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini.
Prompt engineering.
AI automation for operations.
AI chatbot implementation.
AI knowledge base development.
AI-enabled process automation.
AI for ticket triage in support environments.
AI workflow optimization.
AI-driven reporting.

Language Requirements

Local Language: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.
English: Strong professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Application Process
Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

ndangira.description:
Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards
Company: RwandAir LtdLocation: Kigali International Airport, RwandaDepartment: HR & AdministrationReports to: Chief HR & Administration OfficerDeadline: 28 September 2026
RwandAir Ltd, the flag carrier airline of Rwanda, is seeking a qualified and experienced professional to fill the position of Head of Organization Design & Total Rewards.
Job Purpose
The successful candidate will lead the development of RwandAir’s organization design, job architecture, workforce planning, compensation, benefits, grading and total rewards frameworks across a workforce of approximately 1,200–1,500 employees.
Key Responsibilities

Lead organization design and structural reviews across RwandAir’s major functions.

Develop and implement an enterprise-wide job architecture covering job families, career levels and role profiles.

Establish workforce planning methods and productivity ratios.

Develop RwandAir’s Total Rewards philosophy and compensation framework.

Lead job evaluation, grading, salary structures and market benchmarking.

Design compensation rules for flight crew, technical staff and other workforce groups.

Oversee benefits including medical insurance, pension, staff travel and housing.

Advise senior management on employment costs, restructuring and rewards strategy.

Ensure organizational changes maintain regulatory accountability and safety requirements.

Build and lead a technically strong Organization Design & Rewards team.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Industrial/Organisational Psychology or a related field.

10–12 years of progressive HR experience.

At least 5–6 years of specialist experience in rewards, job architecture or organization design.

A Master’s degree in a relevant field is strongly preferred.

Accreditation in Korn Ferry Hay, Mercer IPE or WTW GGS is strongly preferred.

Essential Experience & Skills

Experience leading at least one enterprise-wide job evaluation and grading implementation in an organization with 1,000+ employees.

Experience in aviation or another regulated, multi-site and safety-critical industry.

Experience designing pay structures for technical, operational, unionized, expatriate and local employees.

Experience presenting compensation and organizational decisions at Board or ExCo level.

Strong organization design, compensation and benefits expertise.

Advanced workforce analytics and cost-modelling skills.

Knowledge of aviation operating fundamentals, including ICAO, IOSA, RCAA, FTL, crew productivity, CASK and ASK.

Working knowledge of Rwandan Labour Law No. 66/2018.

Strong HRIS/ERP and organizational modelling skills.

Application Requirements
Applicants should submit:

Application letter addressed to the Chief HR & Administration Officer

Recent Curriculum Vitae

Notarized copies of Degree/Diploma certificates

Relevant professional certificates

Copies of academic papers

Copy of Passport/National ID

Three referees

Application Deadline: 28 September 2026
Application: Submit your application online through the RwandAir e-Recruitment portal.

Sector:

An opening has arisen within Letshego Rwanda Limited LRL for the below-mentioned position. This role is tenable at LRL. The incumbent will serve as a key member of the Country management team (CMC). The requirements of the role are outlined below:

Reports to: The incumbent will report to Chief Executive Officer.
Location: Head Office (Kigali, Rwanda)

Key Accountabilities:

Responsible for the country human capital strategy aligned with the Group's people culture and strategy to contribute to a motivated workforce.

Responsible for creating a compelling Letshego employer brand that attracts diverse, experienced, and capable talent.
Ensures performance management programs, supporting systems, and processes align with strategy and goals, driving the annual country performance review process.
Responsible for talent development, succession planning, and management programs.
Responsible for competitive rewards programs to attract and retain key players in a highly competitive industry.
Responsible for the succession planning process to ensure management and professional readiness to meet the subsidiary's growth plans
Responsible for measuring metrics that support business goals, necessary aspects of human capital, and training and development.
Oversees the learning and development program in line with business requirements.
Ensures adherence to HC policies and procedures to promote a conducive working environment.
Responsible for promoting people wellness through the implementation of a wellness strategy.
Provides advice in disciplinary and grievance procedures.
Implements the strategies and policies approved by the Board, developing processes that adequately identify, measure, monitor, and control risks faced by the institution.

Strategy Execution
Employee Engagement
Budget Plan vs Expenditure
Talent Attraction, Acquisition, Development, and Retention
Employee Engagement
Compensation Management

ndangira.title: Legal Officer  at Gabiro Agribusiness Hub (GAH) Ltd
ndangira.title_raw: Legal Officer  at Gabiro Agribusiness Hub (GAH) Ltd: (Deadline 05-10-2026)
ndangira.description:
JOB VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT
Location: Nyagatare District, Rwanda
1.About GAH Ltd
Gabiro Agribusiness Hub Ltd (GAH Ltd) is a flagship agribusiness initiative established through a partnership between the Government of Rwanda and NETAFIM Ltd, a global leader in precision irrigation solutions. Located in Nyagatare District, GAH Ltd is at the forefront of transforming Rwanda’s agricultural sector through large-scale irrigated farming, modern agribusiness infrastructure, and climate-smart agriculture. The Hub is designed to drive modern, irrigated agriculture, enhance productivity, and attract commercial farming investment.
The Hub was established to drive agricultural commercialization, enhance food security, promote technology-driven farming, and attract private sector investment into high-value agriculture. Through its integrated irrigation infrastructure and modern farming ecosystem, GAH Ltd aims to position Rwanda as a regional model for sustainable and productive agribusiness development. 
2. About the Position
Job Title: Legal Officer 
Reporting to: CEO
Contract Terms: Open Ended
As the organization continues to scale its operations, we are seeking to recruit a competent candidate to fill the position of Legal Officer, who will be responsible for overseeing and managing the legal aspects of the company's operations. This role requires a deep understanding of corporate law, contract management, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to provide sound legal advice and guidance to the management team.
3. Duties & Responsibilities

Provide legal guidance and support to the management team on a wide range of legal issues, including but not limited to contracts, corporate governance, compliance, and regulatory matters.
Review, draft, and participate in negotiation of various contracts, agreements, and legal documents to ensure they adhere to the company's policies and comply with relevant laws and regulations.
Conduct legal research and analysis to stay updated on changes in laws and regulations that may affect the company's operations, and make recommendations to ensure compliance.
Collaborate with different departments to develop and/or update existing internal policies and procedures to mitigate legal risks and ensure the company's operations align with legal standards and best practices.
Collaborate with external legal counsel, as necessary, to handle complex legal matters and represent the company's interests in legal proceedings or negotiations.
Assist in the resolution of legal disputes and litigation, including managing external legal resources and representing the company in negotiations, mediations, and arbitrations.
Work closely with other departments, such as finance, human resources, and operations, to ensure legal compliance in all aspects of the business.
Conduct legal due diligence for potential business transactions, partnerships, and acquisitions to assess and mitigate legal risks.
Prepare and deliver training sessions and workshops to educate employees on legal matters, policies, and compliance requirements.
Keep accurate and up-to-date records of all legal documents, contracts, and correspondences.

4. Required Qualifications
The ideal candidate should possess:

Bachelor's degree in law (LLB)) from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 4 years of experience working as a legal officer or in a similar legal role, preferably in the agricultural or agribusiness sector.
In-depth knowledge of corporate law, contract law, and regulatory compliance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to provide strategic legal advice and solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex legal issues clearly and effectively.
Proven track record of managing legal contracts and negotiations effectively.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Familiarity with relevant software and tools for legal research and document management.

5. Key competencies
The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:

Legal Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and proactively mitigate legal risks arising from the company’s operations, transactions, contracts, and business relationships.
Strategic Legal Advisory: Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, commercially sound recommendations that support management decision-making and the company’s strategic objectives.
Contract Negotiation and Management: Strong ability to develop and negotiate agreements while protecting the company’s interests, maintaining balanced commercial relationships, and ensuring effective contract implementation.

Corporate Governance: Sound understanding of good governance principles, board and management.

6. How to apply 
Interested candidates should submit the following documents compiled into a single PDF file:

Application letter addressed to the Chief Executive Officer of GAH Ltd
Curriculum Vitae (CV) with three referees and their contact details
Copy of the relevant academic degree and professional certificates
Copy of National ID
Proof of required work experience

Applications should be sent to: recruitment@gah.rw
Deadline for submission:Monday, 05th October, 2026 at 5 pm.
Done on 14 September 2026

Job description

About Raising The Village
At Raising The Village (RTV), we are dedicated to eradicating ultra-poverty in Sub-Saharan Africa. As a dynamic, rapidly growing international development organization, we’ve assembled a team of over 350+ passionate individuals in Uganda, Rwanda, DRC and Tanzania, alongside an additional 15+ professionals in North America. Together, we are committed to elevating communities out of ultra-poverty by implementing innovative solutions and leveraging advanced data analytics to drive impact. 
To date, our holistic approach has positively impacted over 1,000,000 lives since 2012, and we’re poised to achieve even greater milestones, aiming to assist 1 million individuals annually by 2027. Our growth and success are fueled by the invaluable support of global partners who share our vision of sustainable change. Learn more about our impactful programs at www.raisingthevillage.org
Position Summary
Position Purpose is to Support the Finance Team to ensure accurate bookkeeping, budget formulation, financial analysis, monitoring, reporting and accounting/budget execution across assigned field districts. Update finance systems with timely and accurate financial data; participate in monthly Sage project reconciliations.
Support budgeting, budget tracking and implementation of financial policies; act as finance business partner to assigned field offices.

Post journal entries (JE), manage fuel accountability and government official payment records.

Strong numerical, analytical, and Excel skills.
Knowledge of accounting standards, financial regulations, and data privacy principles.
High integrity, discretion, and ability to manage confidential information.
Good time management and attention to detail.
Critical thinking and business service orientation.
Willingness to travel up to 30% to field districts.

ndangira.description:
CHAI RWANDA
VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT
Title: Associate, Data Scientist 
Program: Health Systems Strengthening
Job Location: Kigali, Rwanda
Type: Full-Time Paid
Start date: Immediate
Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work in conjunction with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.
At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work: http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org
CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.
Programs Overview
The Government of Rwanda (GoR) strives to achieve Universal Health Coverage (UHC) by enabling equitable access to quality health services for the population as outlined in the Fourth Health Sector Strategic Plan (HSSP IV). This commitment has been made against a backdrop of rising health care costs and uncertainty around the future availability of donor funding and calls for improved health sector sustainability. Acknowledging this, the Government aims to employ effective, equitable, efficient, and sustainable health care financing and systems strengthening, putting an emphasis on primary health care as the cornerstone of a strong and sustainable health system.
CHAI Rwanda’s Health System Strengthening (HSS) programs work on a day-to-day basis with Government leadership in the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB). The goal of those programs is to support the Government to accelerate progress towards UHC by ensuring the sustainable delivery of quality, essential health services. This includes designing and implementing national Primary Health Care (PHC) reforms from health center level down to community health, to increase health workforce availability, to prioritize and sustainably finance essential services, and to support improved management, financing, and delivery of quality primary health care.
Position overview 
CHAI currently seeks an Associate Data Scientist to work with the Ministry of Health (MOH), reporting directly to the head of data science at the National Health Intelligence Center to help improve the quality, governance, and use of evidence on policy decision making. S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI supported initiatives.
The Associate Data Scientist is responsible for leading advanced data analytics, statistical modeling, and applied machine learning across priority public health and clinical domains. The role ensures that health data is transformed into high-quality, reliable, explainable, and decision-ready intelligence that informs AI development, policy decisions, and health system performance improvement. This role serves as the technical bridge between raw health data, AI models, and real-world decision-making, ensuring scientific rigor, reproducibility, and national-scale usability.
This is a top government priority for MOH, and the Associate, Data Scientist will therefore be seconded to the MOH/NHIC, S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI-supported initiatives.
Job responsibilities: 
The key functions and deliverables of this role will include:
Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Modeling 

Lead advanced descriptive, predictive, and inferential analyses across clinical, surveillance, and health systems datasets.
Develop and validate predictive models, risk stratification algorithms, forecasting models, epidemiological and operational analytics
Apply rigorous statistical methods, hypothesis testing, and causal inference techniques to support decision-making.
Ensure all analytics are clinically interpretable, policy-relevant, and scientifically defensible. 

Feature Engineering & Machine Learning Support

Design robust feature engineering pipelines from EMRs, HMIS, LMIS and surveillance platforms
Support AI Engineers with high-quality training datasets, feature selection, bias detection and data representativeness testing
Contribute to development of machine learning models, particularly in tabular health data, time-series forecasting and population-level risk prediction.

Data Quality, Governance and Integrity

Lead implementation of data quality frameworks, completeness, consistency, accuracy and timeliness checks
Perform data audits, outlier detection, bias and missing data analysis
Ensure compliance with national health data governance standards, privacy and ethical data use policies. 
Maintain full data documentation, metadata standards, and lineage tracking. 

Health Systems Intelligence & Decision Support

Develop decision-support analytics and public health dashboards for disease burden tracking,

resource allocation and service delivery optimization. 

Translate analytical outputs into policy briefs, executive dashboards, technical report. 
Ensure outputs are actionable, explainable, and aligned with the national health priorities.

Data Engineering Support and Pipeline optimization

Work closely with Data engineers, integration teams and AI engineers to ensure analytics assets are scalable, reproducible and production ready. 
Support data pipeline optimization, ETL quality validation and real-time and batch processing readiness 

Mentorship, Capacity Building & Collaboration

Mentor junior data scientists and analysts
Lead internal analytics communities of practice, code reviews and methodology workshops
Serve as a technical reviewer for analytics protocols, research designs and data science deliverables

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Stay current with advances in Machine Learning, Statistical Science, Health Analytics, Artificial Intelligence and Causal Inference trends
Propose innovative analytics and data science use cases for public health, service delivery, health financing, supply chain and logistics for pharmaceuticals and disease surveillance

Required Qualifications 

MSc degree in relevant discipline (Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics)
5-8 years of professional experience in the field of advanced analytics and/or applied statistics preferably with Data Science applications
Solid mathematical foundation and knowledge of a variety of statistical methods (e.g. regression, classification, clustering, experimental design, modeling, advanced forecasting) 
Proven experience working with large-scale datasets, regulated data environments, preferably within a health domain. 
Strong proficiency in data visualization, demonstrated experience in Python, R, SQL, and working with structured, semi-structured and unstructured datasets
Ability to focus on vaguely defined problems requiring the application of a creative approach. 
Strong teamworking skills 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams. 
Ability to mentor and lead teams in a fast-paced and changing environment. 

Application procedure 
Interested candidates should email a letter of interest (maximum 1 page) outlining how their background meets the requirements outlined above; CV (maximum 3 pages); and the names of three references through chairwandarecruiting@clintonhealthaccess.org with " Associate, Data Scientist " in the subject line. The deadline for applications is October 09, 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
In compliance with the data protection law of Rwanda and by submitting your application and CV, you explicitly consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal data by Clinton Health Access Initiative for the sole purpose of managing and conducting the recruitment process for the position for which you have applied.

Job Title: Customer Service Agent
Department: Communications
Location: AC Mobility Offices, Kigali - Rwanda
Modality: Full-Time 
Contract Duration: One Year 
Contract Type: Fixed Term
Reporting Structure:

Direct Supervisor/Reports To: Head of Communications 
Works Closely With: Solutions Support Associate 

Role Overview
As the Customer Service Agent, you are responsible for providing timely, professional, and empathetic frontline assistance to AC Mobility customers across all customer-care touchpoints. The role serves as a primary point of contact for commuter enquiries, complaints, and service requests, ensuring accurate information is provided, resolving standard issues at the first point of contact, and properly documenting and escalating complex cases requiring technical or operational investigation.
Core Responsibility
To provide customers with a reliable, reassuring, and positive support experience by understanding their needs, delivering accurate information, achieving high first-contact resolution on routine enquiries, and ensuring unresolved issues are documented and routed efficiently through established escalation pathways.
Key Responsibilities

Frontline Customer Support: Receive, handle, and resolve incoming customer enquiries and complaints professionally, courteously, and empathetically. 
Customer Information Delivery: Provide clear, precise, and up-to-date guidance regarding AC Mobility products, Tap&Go fare structures, card usage, and service procedures. 
First Contact Resolution (FCR): Resolve routine, frequently occurring customer enquiries (such as balance queries, basic card issues, and system guidance) during the initial interaction.
Complaint Handling and De-escalation: Actively listen to customer grievances, defuse tense interactions with composure, and provide appropriate assistance while upholding professional standards. 
Follow-up and Communication: Contact commuters to provide progress updates, request additional information, or confirm the successful resolution of reported issues. 
CRM and Case Management: Accurately record, categorise, and manage all customer interactions, service requests, and feedback within the company’s CRM and ticketing systems. 
Tier-2 Escalation: Accurately document and escalate technical faults, transactional discrepancies, or operational challenges to the Solutions Support Associate in line with standard operating procedures. 
Customer Feedback Logging: Systematically identify and flag recurring commuter pain points, agent network issues, or validator failure patterns to supervisory and technical teams. 
Data Security and Confidentiality: Maintain absolute discretion and protect sensitive commuter identity, card data, and transaction histories in strict adherence to data protection standards. 
Continuous Learning and Compliance: Maintain a thorough understanding of AC Mobility platforms, updates, workflows, and assigned shift rotas. 

Working Relationship with the Solutions Support Associate

The Customer Service Agent provides Tier-1 frontline support, handling initial commuter engagements and resolving routine queries using documented procedures. 

Where an issue requires technical diagnosis, backend transaction verification, or cross-departmental coordination, the Agent documents the case and formally escalates it to the Solutions Support Associate. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

First Contact Resolution (FCR): Achieve ≥80% resolution rate on standard enquiries during the first interaction. 
Response and Resolution Timelines: Adhere strictly to agreed customer response and ticket resolution times across all live support channels. 
Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): Maintain a positive customer satisfaction rating of ≥85% based on post-interaction feedback. 
CRM Record Accuracy: 100% of customer interactions accurately tagged, documented, and categorised with zero critical omissions. 
Escalation Accuracy: Zero critical misroutings of technical or operational tickets escalated to the Solutions Support Associate. 
Schedule Adherence: High punctuality and compliance with allocated shift rotas and operational breaks. 

Performance Evaluation and Terms
Performance in this role will be continuously evaluated to ensure against customer care benchmarks, response accuracy, and adherence to operational standards. 
Ramifications of Underperformance:
Expectations for this role are high, reflecting its importance to the organisation's overall success. A sustained failure to achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), fulfil core responsibilities, or uphold AC Mobility’s standards of professional conduct will trigger a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). Inability to demonstrate the required improvement within the stipulated timeframe may result in the termination of employment.
Qualifications and Core Competencies
1. Educational Background

Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Customer Care, Communications, Public Relations, Business Administration, or a related field. 

2. Professional Experience

Prior customer-facing or call centre experience within technology, telecommunications, financial services, or transport environments is an added advantage.

3. Language Proficiency

Fluency in Kinyarwanda and English is required; working knowledge of French is an added advantage.

4. Professional Certifications
Preferred: 

Certified Customer Service Professional (CCSP) or Customer Service Excellence Certification (CSEC): Demonstrates mastery of foundational service principles, complaint resolution, and front-facing relationship management.
Help Desk Institute (HDI) Support Center Analyst: Validates best-practice competencies in multi-channel ticket logging, service desk workflows, and issue escalation.
ITIL Foundation (v4): Recommended for agents operating alongside technical teams to understand incident ticketing, service level agreements (SLAs), and change escalation procedures.
CRM Platform Certifications: Practical product badges or credentials in industry-standard ticketing and CRM suites (such as Zendesk, HubSpot Service Hub, or Salesforce Service Cloud).

5. Additional Hard Competencies

CRM and Ticketing Systems: Competence in logging, categorising, and tracking tickets within enterprise CRM or customer support software. 
Digital Literacy: Comfort working across multiple web applications, digital mobility tools, and office productivity platforms with high typing speed and accuracy. 
Product Literacy: Comprehensive understanding of cashless payment flows, bus ticketing workflows, and Tap&Go operational rules.

Soft Competencies

Command of key competencies needed for the modern workplace, including but not limited to: Strategic Leadership, High-Level Problem Solving, Critical Thinking, Uncompromising Integrity, Excellent Cross-Functional Communication, Work Ethic, Dependability, Empathy, Professionalism, and effective Stress Management in high-stakes environments. 

In addition:

Customer-Centric Communication: Active listening and clear, professional verbal and written expression across diverse commuter demographics.
Emotional Resilience and De-escalation: Proven ability to remain calm, patient, and polite when managing difficult situations or high-volume peak periods.
Attention to Detail and Accuracy: Rigour in recording accurate ticket details, capturing caller data, and relaying factual procedural information.
Dependability and Process Discipline: Strict adherence to shift rosters, attendance guidelines, SOPs, and tiered escalation matrices.
Ethical Conduct and Discretion: Absolute integrity and responsible handling of private commuter and transaction records.

What We Offer
AC Mobility offers a vibrant, purpose-driven workplace at the forefront of East Africa’s cashless transit revolution. As a Customer Service Agent, you will join a supportive, collaborative Communications and Customer Care team dedicated to delivering world-class service to millions of daily commuters. We offer competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health insurance coverage, structured shift patterns, continuous professional coaching in modern CRM platforms and conflict de-escalation, and clear internal career progression pathways into technical support, operations, or supervisory roles within the organisation.
Application Instructions
Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to submit their applications through the AC Mobility recruitment portal using the link below:
Application link: https://acm-odoogit-odooerp.odoo.com/jobs/customer-service-agent-52
Application deadline: 10 October 2026
CLICK HERE TO READ MORE AND APPLY

ndangira.description:
Imyanya 4,767 ya EC-2026 mu Mirenge yose y’u Rwanda – NISR Irashaka Enumerators (A1, A0 na A2) | Selection Test: 4–17 Ukwakira 2026
Hakenewe abantu 4,767 bazakorera mu Mirenge yose y’u Rwanda, aho urutonde rwa NISR rugaragaza umubare w’abakenewe muri buri Murenge.
Aba Enumerators bazaba bafite inshingano zo gusura ibigo n’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi biri mu duce bahawe, gukusanya amakuru no kuyashyikiriza NISR.
Abashaka uyu mwanya basabwa kuba bujuje ibi bikurikira:

Kuba ari Umunyarwanda
Kuba afite smartphone cyangwa tablet ikora neza
Kuba ari mu database ya National Youth Council
Kuba afite hagati y’imyaka 16 na 30
Kuba atuye mu Murenge azakoramo
Kuba afite A1 cyangwa A0 mu bijyanye na Statistics, Economics, Social Studies cyangwa izindi ngeri zijyanye na byo; A2 ishobora kwitabwaho igihe nta bafite impamyabumenyi ya kaminuza bahari
Kuba ashobora gukora kuva 10 Ukuboza 2026 kugeza 10 Gashyantare 2027, kandi muri icyo gihe akaba adafite indi nshingano y'akazi
Kuba ashobora gukorera no mu duce twa kure
Kuba afite imyitwarire myiza kandi yubahiriza amahame
Kuba yarigeze kugira uruhare mu mabarura yabanje ni inyongera

Smartphone cyangwa Tablet bisabwa
Igikoresho kizakoreshwa kigomba kuba gifite nibura:

Android 7.0 cyangwa irenga
RAM 4GB cyangwa irenga
10GB y’ububiko busigaye
Battery ishobora kumara nibura amasaha 8
Wi-Fi na mobile data 3G/4G LTE
Bluetooth
USB port

Uko abazakora bazatoranywa
NISR ivuga ko recruitment izakorwa mu byiciro bibiri:
1. Initial pre-selectionAbujuje ibisabwa bazabanza gutoranywa ku rwego rw'Umurenge, hashingiwe ku mubare w'abakenewe muri buri Murenge.
2. Selection testAbazaba baratoranyijwe bazakora ikizamini cya NISR ku rwego rw'Akarere. Iri tangazo rivuga ko ibizamini bizakorwa hagati ya 4 na 17 Ukwakira 2026.
Reba Umurenge wawe
Urutonde rwa NISR rugaragaza Umurenge, Akarere n'umubare w'abakenewe. Umuntu ashobora kureba Umurenge atuyemo kugira ngo amenye umubare w'abakandida bakenewe aho atuye.
📄 Download Recruitment-Plan-EC-2026-1.pdf
SOMA IMYANYA YOSE HANO KURI LINK:  Imyanya y'akazi yose.pdf
📄 Download Imyanya y'akazi yose.pdf1

ndangira.title: Applications Specialist at HOPE International
ndangira.title_raw: Applications Specialist at HOPE International: (Deadline 27-09-2026)
ndangira.description:
Applications SpecialistROLE DESCRIPTION
Application deadline: September 27, 2026
The applications specialist will have responsibility for ensuring the effective deployment and support of Temenos T24 and other banking applications in HOPE’s network of microfinance institutions and banks. This is accomplished through enhancing the parameterization of T24 to support the needs of management teams, assisting in new system deployments, fixing problems as they arise, and training and equipping country level staff.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda; other geographies possible for consultancy ,
Level: Senior Professional
Type: Full-time
Department: Core Banking Systems & Applications
Reports to: Senior Applications Specialist

RESPONSIBILITIES

Promote and fulfill the mission and vision of HOPE International.
System Development & Implementation
Utilize expertise in T24 to assist in the configuration and parameterization of T24 in new deployments so as to maximize effectiveness of the system and ensure that appropriate functionality is utilized
Develop, enhance, and customize T24 AA modules, products, and lifecycle events
Work on AA Contracts, AA Components, L3 customizations, and COB activities
Assist in development and implementation of both in-house and third-party core banking software integrations to T24
Recommend improvements to existing T24 technical and business processes in order to ensure the effective fulfillment of functional requirements
Equip Country-Level T24 Support Staff
Provide training, advice and mentoring to country-level T24 support staff
Approach each problem with an attitude of service and take every reasonable opportunity to turn projects into teaching moments
Provide Effective Second Level Support
Respond in a timely fashion to the real-time support needs of programs, resolving problems and minimizing disruption to banking services
Provide proactive mitigation of potential problems by identifying system risks and reconfiguring T24 to prevent either system malfunction or a mismatch of system capabilities with program needs
Learn and support integrated digital financial applications such as mobile payment products and web-based T24 front ends
Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to core-banking systems and other systems used by HOPE-led financial institutions.
Center of Excellence
Maintain expertise in recent releases of T24 MCB so as to serve the HOPE Network as a center of excellence for T24 best practices and functionality
Other
Perform other technical assistance functions as necessary, including responding to information requests from other departments

QUALIFICATIONS

Personal confession of Christian faith and commitment to the mission and vision of HOPE International.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field;
5-10 years of experience supporting T24 in commercial or microfinance banks, with specific experience with T24 AA required
Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines
Excellent project management skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to conduct comparative analysis and prepare recommendations for presentation to senior leadership
Cross-cultural intelligence and communication skills
Experience with Excel and other Microsoft Office Suite products
Fluent in English
Proficiency in French preferred
Extended cross-cultural living experience preferred

Apply Here: Applications Specialist | HOPE International
